text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-ops-0417","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_batch7_followup","campaign_class":"routine_composition_screen","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before swap"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-7731","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO plate per batch7 SOP"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-7731"},"comment":"init and register fiducials"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo + Sn baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"thermal_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":180,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization step, same profile as batch6 oxide calcination (label: 'calcine_std')"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-7731","position":[12,34]},"comment":"locate sample spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, standard"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"duration":7200},"comment":"2h stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"dataset":"batch7_followup"},"comment":"append results to GP surrogate"}]}
